Associate Product Manager - Founder's Office
CRED
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (On-site)

About CRED:
CRED is an exclusive community for high-trust individuals rewarding financial discipline.

The Opportunity:
Work alongside the founders to launch 0 to 1 high-impact initiatives. You will operate at the intersection of product management, business strategy, and rapid experimentation.

What we expect:
• 1-2 years of experience in product management, strategy, or high-growth venture-backed startups.
• Proven ability to conceptualize PRDs, drive user research, and run sprint execution.
• Degree from Tier-1 institutes (IIT/BITS/IIM) preferred.
• High taste in design, analytical rigor with SQL, and hunger for zero-to-one problem solving.
